title: Pappi Yona'ah

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Batra 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.25b.14), [as one] who was poor and became wealthy. He came before Rav Ashi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage adds that the wealthy Pappi built a mansion and came before Rav Ashi about the neighboring sesame presses that shook it.
Hyman spells the byname יונאה, as does the linked text.
